stem: A worker must attach trellis hardware across a wide section and would need repeated sideways reaching from a step ladder. What is the best first decision?
choices: Use a taller ladder so fewer climbs are needed
Select a more stable work method or redesign the task to avoid repeated overreach
Ask a coworker to hold the ladder while the worker reaches farther
Complete the task quickly before fatigue develops
rationale: When the task requires repeated wide reaching or sustained two-hand work, access-method selection should be reconsidered instead of compensating for poor task fit.
